description: Tells Jellyfin about new and removed files, and reads what you watched there for suggestions and play links.

settings.url_help: For example http://jellyfin:8096. How its folders look to Reelix is the path map under Settings → Media server.
settings.public_url_help: The address your phone and browser use for Jellyfin, if different from the one above (for example when it is a Docker name). Used for “Open in Jellyfin”.
settings.watch_users_help: Jellyfin user names. Empty: the only user, or else the administrators.
